A '''sensor computer''' was a type of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] used in [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]]. The [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] computer complied data gathered by the sensors, which was then used by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and operators to assist in a multitude of duties such as plotting navigational courses and scanning other [[Starship/Legends|vessels]].<ref name="EGWT" />
